name: 04a. Gemma 4 - Video to Prompt
description: 04a. Gemma 4 - Video to Prompt is a image to video workflow designed to animate a still image into a generated video clip using Gemma 4. Its 9-node graph exposes 2 prompt/text field(s), 0 media input target(s), and 0 save/preview stage(s), while preserving the original editor-format graph for reference. The ComfyUI editor graph was converted to API format and is ready for live validation against the connected node and model registry.
instructions:
1. Open the workflow and select Validate. SineForge will compare every node class and input against the currently connected ComfyUI instance without queueing it.
2. Review the model-file entries in Requirements and place each checkpoint, text encoder, VAE, LoRA, or auxiliary model in the folder documented by the source workflow. Refresh ComfyUI after adding files.
3. No required media file was detected in the converted graph; begin with the prompt and generation controls.
4. Set frame count, FPS, dimensions, conditioning strength, and seed. Start with one short clip to verify motion, identity, and memory use before scaling up.
5. Save a copy before making structural changes. Use Editable inputs for normal parameters and Raw API JSON only when you need to inspect or change graph wiring.
6. Validate again after every change. Queue one workflow only after validation passes; then inspect the returned output, logs, duration, dimensions, and media integrity.

requirements.documentation_notes:
A highly detailed, photorealistic rendering of an adorable white rabbit character dressed in a delicate pink ballet tutu and matching pink pointe shoes. The rabbit has large, expressive eyes and a sweet, animated facial expression, conveying joy and grace. Throughout the sequence, the character performs various graceful ballet poses, transitioning from a charming, slightly playful stance to more dynamic, elegant movements across the frame. The environment is a soft, diffused studio setting with a gentle gradient background of pale pink and muted gray. Cinematic lighting highlights the texture of the fur and the ruffles of the tutu, creating a high-quality, whimsical, and enchanting mood with sharp focus on the subject's intricate details and natural motion. Analyze the video and create a detailed prompt only. Describe the main subject, appearance, clothing, facial expression, pose, action, movement, environment, camera angle, framing, lighting, mood, colors, background, and important visual details. Include how the subject moves or changes during the clip. Write it as one natural prompt with rich visual description, suitable for video or image generation. Use terms like realistic, cinematic lighting, sharp focus, natural motion, detailed face, and high quality when appropriate. Do not explain. Do not use bullet points. Do not mention that this is a video. Output only one detailed prompt, around 100 to 160 words, no extra text. {"version":1,"content":"

Core Capabilities

Gemma 4 models handle a broad range of tasks across text, vision, and audio.

  • Thinking – Built-in reasoning mode that lets the model think step-by-step before answering.
  • Long Context – Context windows of up to 128K tokens for E2B/E4B
  • Image Understanding – Object detection, document/PDF parsing, screen and UI understanding, chart comprehension, OCR including multilingual text, handwriting recognition, and pointing. Images can be processed at variable aspect ratios and resolutions.
  • Video Understanding – Analyze video by processing sequences of frames.
  • Interleaved Multimodal Input – Freely mix text and images in any order within a single prompt.
  • Function Calling – Native support for structured tool use, enabling agentic workflows.
  • Coding – Code generation, completion, and correction.
  • Multilingual – Out-of-the-box support for 35+ languages, pre-trained on 140+ languages.
  • Audio (E2B and E4B only) – Automatic speech recognition and speech-to-translated-text translation across multiple languages.
